metadata.title: Pegylated Liposomal Doxorubicin 50 mg/m² – 28 day
metadata.indication: Metastatic breast cancer; advanced ovarian cancer after first-line platinum failure; metastatic soft-tissue sarcoma; recurrent or advanced endometrial cancer.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Organ-function values or categories are optional; omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source-audited encoding · independent clinical/pharmacy review pending

organ_function_reconciliation.note: NCCP v 8 Tables 1–3 reconciled, including absolute bilirubin thresholds, source gaps and haemodialysis. Independent validation pending.

metadata.schedule_summary: Pegylated liposomal doxorubicin 50 mg/m² IV on day 1 every 28 days; typically 6 cycles or continued until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
audited_eligibility: 00205 b: advanced ovarian cancer after failure of first-line platinum chemotherapy; ECOG 0–3
00205 d: recurrent or advanced endometrial cancer; ECOG 0–3
Adequate haematological, liver and cardiac function
audit_limitations: Independent Consultant and oncology-pharmacy validation remains pending.
Table 1 overlaps platelet <50 and <25 rows: the specific severe <25 row governs delay and Consultant choice of 25% reduction OR full dose with growth-factor support.
Table 1 leaves fractional platelets between 74 and 75 unassigned; Table 2 leaves bilirubin >50 to <51 µmol/L unassigned; both require source interpretation.
Table 3 current-grade and delay-week inputs are required; a 25% toxicity reduction has no explicitly stated original-versus-current dose basis, so no automatic numerical restart dose is calculated.
NCCP Table 2 hepatic percentages and >86 restriction are retained; differing EMA hepatic initiation/re-escalation instructions are not blended into the NCCP pathway.
No universal CT, tumour-marker, ECG calendar or routine three-month echo interval is specified.
450 mg/m² is a trigger for LVEF assessment before each additional administration exceeding the threshold, not an automatic lifetime treatment stop.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: All dose modifications require Consultant discussion. Resolve concurrent reasons, original/current dose history and ambiguous source rows before prescribing; the decision tool is not treatment clearance.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00205 Version 8. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.
clinical_governance.organ_function_rule_status: Source audited in v0.84.1; independent Consultant and oncology-pharmacy validation pending.

eligibility: 00205 b: advanced ovarian cancer after failure of first-line platinum chemotherapy; ECOG 0–3
00205 d: recurrent or advanced endometrial cancer; ECOG 0–3
Adequate haematological, liver and cardiac function
exclusions: Hypersensitivity to pegylated liposomal doxorubicin, peanut, soya or excipients (NCCP p 2)
Do not substitute non-pegylated liposomal doxorubicin (Myocet) for this formulation (NCCP p 1)
monitoring: Before first treatment: FBC, renal/liver profile, ECG and ECHO/MUGA to establish LVEF (p 2).
Before each 28 day cycle: FBC, renal/liver profile; assess PPE and oral symptoms (p 2).

During treatment: regular/frequent ECG; ECHO/MUGA LVEF as clinically indicated. Before EACH additional administration exceeding lifetime cumulative anthracycline 450 mg/m², LVEF assessment is mandatory (pp 2,4).
Response imaging and other disease tests follow the Consultant treatment plan; NCCP 00205 does not mandate universal 3 monthly CT or tumour-marker testing (p 2).
dose_modifications: NCCP Table 1: ANC<1.5 or qualifying low platelets delay until both recovery values; severe ANC<0.5 or platelets<25 leads to a Consultant choice of 25% reduction OR full dose with growth-factor support.

NCCP Table 2: no expected renal or haemodialysis adjustment; absolute bilirubin 20–50 uses 75%original,51–86 uses 50%original,>86 not recommended. Printed gaps and contradictory entered values require review.

NCCP Table 3: current PPE/stomatitis grade, prior severe skin/mouth toxicity and 0/1/2 weeks delay jointly determine redose, delay,25% reduction/possible stomatitis discontinuation, or discontinuation. Ambiguous numerical dose basis remains specialist review.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: NCCP 00205 v 8 p 3 explicitly classifies PLD as low emetic risk; local policy applies.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for low emetogenic risk
additional_supportive_care: PPE prevention for 4–7 days after infusion: keep hands/feet cool, avoid heat/hot water and tight footwear/clothing; follow local advice.
Check oral symptoms and provide mouth-care advice; assess painful ulceration and difficulty eating promptly.
Anaphylaxis/reaction management facilities required; first infusion rate 1 mg/min, subsequent 60 min only if tolerated.
Growth-factor support is one Consultant-selected alternative after severe count toxicity; not mandatory primary prophylaxis for everyone.
supportive_care.premedication: None usually required (NCCP p 4). Individualise medicines after an infusion reaction.

treatment_phases.label: Pegylated liposomal doxorubicin
treatment_phases.name: Pegylated liposomal doxorubicin
treatment_phases.number_of_cycles: Typically 6; may continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity

administration.notes: Initial infusion 1 mg/min; subsequent infusions over 60 min if no reaction. Glucose 5%250 mL, or 500 mL for dose≥90 mg. No in-line filter. Modified 90 min reaction pathway requires clinical assessment; do not substitute non-pegylated liposomal doxorubicin/Myocet.
